_doc: Hardcoded FALLBACK thresholds — used ONLY if the backend has never sent a 'config' in the /sensors/telemetry response, or a given field in 'config' is null. Once the backend has sent a valid config for a field, that remote value is used (see config/threshold_resolver.py). The shape of this JSON is DELIBERATELY identical to the shape of the API 'config' so the fallback is per-field, not all-or-nothing.
_waterDangerThreshold_note: Flood depth in metres: AT OR ABOVE this triggers. 0.5 m is an example, not a validated site limit; calibrate before deployment.
_rainfallDangerThreshold_note: Rainfall over the last one hour, in mm. AT OR ABOVE this triggers. 30 mm is an example; calibrate for the installation.

alarm._note: The local siren (relay) only sounds after N CONSECUTIVE readings cross the danger threshold in a row. This is independent of sending the emergency upload to the backend.
